goal: 在课堂讨论中清楚表达观点并说服对方

n1.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n1.line: Our class is debating whether homework should be abolished. What is your stance on this issue?
n1.lineCn: 我们班正在辩论是否应该取消家庭作业。你对这个问题持什么立场?

grammar.name: whether 引导的宾语从句
grammar.note: debating whether homework should be abolished 中 whether 从句作宾语,表二选一的疑问。

options.text: What matters most is not homework itself but how it is designed.
options.textCn: 最重要的不是作业本身,而是它如何被设计。

options.text: I believe that homework is completely unnecessary in the age of the Internet.
options.textCn: 我认为在互联网时代,家庭作业完全没有必要。

options.text: I have not thought about it. Whatever others say, I will agree with the majority.
options.textCn: 我没想过这个问题。无论别人说什么,我都随大流。

n2.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n2.line: Interesting distinction. Could you explain what kind of homework you consider valuable?
n2.lineCn: 有意思的区分。你能解释一下你认为哪种作业有价值吗?

grammar.name: what 引导的宾语从句
grammar.note: explain what kind of homework you consider valuable 中 what 从句作 explain 的宾语。

options.text: I think that tasks requiring deep thinking are valuable, while mechanical copying is not.
options.textCn: 我认为需要深度思考的任务有价值,而机械抄写没有。

options.text: The fact that we finish exercises at home proves nothing about our real understanding.
options.textCn: 我们在家完成练习这个事实,并不能证明我们真正理解了。

options.text: That is what I mean, but I cannot give a clear example right now.
options.textCn: 这正是我的意思,但我现在举不出明确的例子。

n2b.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n2b.line: A fair point. But some people argue that homework trains discipline. How would you answer them?
n2b.lineCn: 有道理。但有人认为作业能锻炼自律。你如何回应他们?

grammar.name: that 引导的宾语从句(主张)
grammar.note: argue that homework trains discipline 中 that 从句作 argue 的宾语,是表明观点的常用句式。

options.text: I would answer that discipline should come from interest, not compulsion.
options.textCn: 我会回答说,自律应源于兴趣,而非强迫。

options.text: What I would say is that discipline has little value if it breeds resentment.
options.textCn: 我想说的是,如果自律孕育怨气,它就没什么价值。

options.text: I have no answer. They may be right, for all I know.
options.textCn: 我没有答案。说不定他们是对的。

n3.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n3.line: That is a bold claim. Are you certain that removing homework will improve our learning?
n3.lineCn: 这是个大胆的主张。你确定取消作业会提高我们的学习效果吗?

grammar.name: that 引导的宾语从句(确信)
grammar.note: certain that removing homework will improve our learning 中 that 从句作形容词 certain 的宾语。

options.text: Yes. What we truly need is time for self-directed study, not endless assignments.
options.textCn: 是的。我们真正需要的是自主学习的时穇,而不是做不完的作业。

options.text: To be honest, I am not sure whether it will help, but I dislike homework anyway.
options.textCn: 老实说,我不确定有没有用,但我就是讨厌作业。
options.feedback: 情感用事,Lucas 会追问证据。

options.text: Whether homework helps or not, I simply refuse to do any more of it.
options.textCn: 不管作业有没有用,我就是拒绝再做。
options.feedback: 任性表态,Lucas 提醒理性。

n4.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n4.line: Sitting on the fence is comfortable, but it persuades no one. What do you actually believe?
n4.lineCn: 骑墙很舒服,但说服不了任何人。你真正相信的是什么?

grammar.name: what 引导的宾语从句(追问)
grammar.note: What do you actually believe 中 what 作 believe 的宾语,疑问词置于句首构成特殊疑问。

options.text: Honestly, what I believe is that moderate homework helps consolidate knowledge.
options.textCn: 说实话,我相信适度的作业有助于巩固知识。
options.feedback: 终于亮明立场,讨论进展。

options.text: I believe whatever the teacher says, so I need your opinion first.
options.textCn: 老师说什么我信什么,所以我先听听你的意见。

options.text: The truth is that I have no opinion, and I am proud of my neutrality.
options.textCn: 事实是我没有观点,而且我为自己的中立骄傲。

n5.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n5.line: Now we are getting somewhere. The question that remains is how we could put your idea into practice.
n5.lineCn: 现在我们有点进展了。剩下的问题是如何把你的想法付诸实践。

grammar.name: 表语从句 how
grammar.note: The question ... is how we could put your idea into practice 中 how 从句作表语,连接主宾信息。

options.text: My suggestion is that we replace daily assignments with weekly projects.
options.textCn: 我的建议是用每周项目取代每日作业。
options.feedback: 提出可行方案,辩论深化。

options.text: What I propose is a compromise: less homework, more classroom discussion.
options.textCn: 我提议折中:减少作业,增加课堂讨论。

options.text: I doubt that teachers will ever accept any of our suggestions.
options.textCn: 我怀疑老师会不会接受我们任何建议。

n5b.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n5b.line: Then we agree on the direction. But which subject should pilot your proposal first?
n5b.lineCn: 那我们在方向上达成一致。但哪个科目该先试点你的提议呢?

grammar.name: which 引导的宾语从句(选择)
grammar.note: which subject should pilot your proposal 作宾语,which 强调在特定范围内的选择。

options.text: What I recommend is piloting it in mathematics, where practice truly matters.
options.textCn: 我建议在数学科试点,因为那里的练习确实重要。

options.text: I suggest English, because the current exercises are the most repetitive.
options.textCn: 我建议英语科,因为现在的练习最机械重复。

options.text: Piloting at all sounds unnecessary to me. Why not change everything at once?
options.textCn: 试点在我看来纯属多余。为什么不一次性全改?

n6.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n6.line: Vague ideas are hard to debate. Let me ask directly: what evidence supports your view?
n6.lineCn: 模糊的想法很难辩论。我直接问:有什么证据支持你的观点?

grammar.name: what 引导的主语从句
grammar.note: What I want from you is evidence 中 what 从句作主语,主语从句的经典用法。

options.text: What I can offer is my own experience: I learn far more from projects than from exercises.
options.textCn: 我能提供的是自身经验:我通过项目学到的远多于通过练习。
options.feedback: 以实例为证,说服力上升。

options.text: I am not sure that evidence matters here. It is all about intuition.
options.textCn: 我不确定证据在这里重要。这全靠直觉。

options.text: Whether you believe me or not, my grades prove that my method works.
options.textCn: 信不信由你,我的成绩证明我的方法有效。

n7.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n7.line: A discussion dies without commitment. The possibility that your silence will be mistaken for agreement is quite high.
n7.lineCn: 没有投入,讨论就会死掉。你的沉默被误认为同意的可能性相当高。

grammar.name: that 引导的同位语从句
grammar.note: the possibility that your silence will be mistaken for agreement 中 that 从句说明 possibility 的内容。

options.text: You have a point. What I should have said is that I support moderate homework.
options.textCn: 你说得对。我本应该说的是我支持适度作业。
options.feedback: 及时修正立场,回到讨论。

options.text: Fine, then let me say this: what I believe is none of your business.
options.textCn: 行,那我就直说:我相信什么与你无关。

options.text: I will commit: I support moderate homework, and I can defend it.
options.textCn: 我表态:我支持适度作业,而且我能为它辩护。

n8.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n8.line: That is a constructive proposal. Why do you think teachers should adopt it?
n8.lineCn: 这是个建设性提议。你为什么认为老师应该采纳它?

grammar.name: why 引导的宾语从句(理由)
grammar.note: Why do you think teachers should adopt it 中 why 从句作 think 的宾语,追问理由。

options.text: I am convinced that project-based learning cultivates skills that last a lifetime.
options.textCn: 我深信项目式学习能培养受益终身的技能。
options.feedback: 理由长远深刻,说服力强。

options.text: The reason is that it balances freedom and discipline.
options.textCn: 理由是它平衡了自由与自律。

options.text: I do not know why you keep questioning me. I am just sharing my opinion.
options.textCn: 我不知道你为什么一直追问。我只是分享观点。
options.feedback: 不耐烦了,Lucas 引导理性。

n8b.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n8b.line: Before we conclude, let me play devil's advocate: what worries me is whether teachers will find time to evaluate weekly projects.
n8b.lineCn: 在结论之前,让我唱唱反调:我担心的是老师能否挤出时间评价每周项目。

grammar.name: whether 引导的表语从句
grammar.note: what worries me is whether teachers will find time... 中 what 从句作主语,whether 从句作表语。

options.text: That is a real concern. What we can do is limit each project to one page.
options.textCn: 这是真实的顾虑。我们能做的是把每个项目限制在一页之内。

options.text: The truth is that evaluation time is the teachers' problem, not ours.
options.textCn: 事实是批改时间是老师的问题,不是我们的。

options.text: I had not considered that risk. What do you suggest we do about it?
options.textCn: 我没考虑过这个风险。你建议我们怎么办?
options.feedback: 虚心求教,继续完善方案。

n9.speaker: 同学 Lucas
n9.line: Excellent reasoning. What you have presented is a well-structured viewpoint, and I am convinced.
n9.lineCn: 推理出色。你所展示的是一个结构完整的观点,我被说服了。

grammar.name: 主语从句总结
grammar.note: What you have presented is... 用 what 从句作主语,是演讲与辩论收尾的正式总结句式。

options.text: Thank you. I am glad that we could reach an agreement through discussion.
options.textCn: 谢谢。我很高兴我们能通过讨论达成一致。

options.text: I am not sure that you will keep your promise, but I appreciate the gesture.
options.textCn: 我不确定你会不会守诺,但我感谢你的态度。

options.text: Actually, forget the whole debate. Whether we agree or not, homework will continue anyway.
options.textCn: 算了,忘掉整场辩论吧。不管我们同不同意,作业都会继续。
options.feedback: 前功尽弃,讨论失望收场。

success.speaker: 同学 Lucas
success.line: Agreed, and this is exactly what a good debate should achieve: a better idea, not a louder voice.
success.lineCn: 同意。这正是一场好的辩论该达成的:更好的想法,而不是更大的嗓门。

fail1.speaker: 同学 Lucas
fail1.line: I am sorry the debate ended that way. A viewpoint without evidence persuades no one.
fail1.lineCn: 辩论这样收场我很遗憾。没有证据的观点说服不了任何人。

fail2.speaker: 同学 Lucas
fail2.line: Giving up midway disappoints everyone who listened to you. I hope you will stand firm next time.
fail2.lineCn: 中途放弃会让所有听你说话的人失望。希望你下次立场坚定。
